correctness.rationale: The twelve arcs of the right S3 Cayley graph use generators of orders 3 and 2, not two reflections. Direct enumeration independently generated all 4096 arc masks, verified the forest condition and face vector (1,12,57,134,156,72). An explicit 213-pair discrete Morse matching on the 431 nonempty faces has an acyclic oriented Hasse graph of 1500 incidences and leaves one zero-dimensional and four four-dimensional cells; Forman’s theorem yields an integral wedge of four S4, not merely field Betti numbers. Signed fixed-simplex Lefschetz traces for six left translations give character values 4 at identity, -2 at each reflection and 1 at nontrivial 3-cycles; rational S3 character inner products yield two signs plus one standard.
risks: Exact right Cayley arcs and one incoming-edge forest convention are essential; different generating sets/edge orientations and integral group-ring module are outside scope.
